title: Ridge to River Outdoors LLC & 365 Charters
specs: Fishing in Puget Sound within sight of land, usually within a mile or less of shore
Heated cabin and enclosed marine restroom on saltwater boat
Use of advanced downriggers for salmon trolling
All anglers aged 15+ must have a valid fishing license; catch record card required for salmon, steelhead, or sturgeon
All ages welcome; kids as young as 2 years old have fished
Bass fishing boat max 2 anglers; saltwater boat max 6 passengers
Private charters require minimum 4 anglers, max 6 passengers on saltwater boat
Shared charters require minimum 2 anglers, max 4-5 for comfort
Bass boat max 2 anglers, no shared boats for bass fishing
includes: Premium rods, reels, bait, and tackle
Complimentary fish cleaning, filleting, and bagging (salmon & bottom fish)
gap: Exact age minimum for children not stated
blurb: Guests fish in Puget Sound or local lakes with guided charters. Trips include all gear, instruction, and fish cleaning. Options include private and shared saltwater charters, flounder trips, and bass fishing on lakes.
extraNote: 30% deposit required to confirm reservation; remaining balance due at boat launch · 3% credit card processing fee charged at booking, non-refundable · Full refund minus 3% fee if cancelled at least 7 days before trip; deposit forfeited if cancelled less than 7 days before · If operator cancels due to weather, option to reschedule or full refund including fees · Tips not included but appreciated; deckhands rely on tips · Shilshole Bay Marina in North Seattle
